deallocator.description: Function that frees a node; if the node is still linked into a tree/list, it must be unlinked first.

unlinker.description: Function that unlinks a node from its parent/children/prev/next links.

content_merger.description: Function that consumes/merges the content of a node before the node is freed.

wrapper.description: Wrapper function that merges content and frees a node; used to scope the pattern.
